جُشَمٌ Weight, or heaviness; (S, K;) as also ↓ جَشَمٌ (K,) and ↓ جَشْمٌ accord. to the K, but correctly ↓ جُشْمٌ , as in the A and L: (TA:) [and
and unpleasing, and a difficult or troublesome or an inconvenient, affair:] a subst. from تَجَشَّمَ كَذَا وَكَذَا. explained above: see 1. (TA.) You say, أَلْقَى فُلَانٌ عَلَىَّ جُشَمَهُ, (S,) or ↓ جَشَمَهُ , (TA,) Such a one threw upon me his weight, or heavi ness: (S, TA:) to which Z adds, or his difficult, or troublesome, or inconvenient, affair, that he had imposed upon himself, or that was imposed upon him. (TA.) ＝
-A2- Also The جَوْف [i. e., the belly; or the chest; &c.]: or the breast, with the ribs that contain it: (K:) or the breast of a camel: (S, TA:) and the part [of the skin] of the camel's breast, and of the rest of the body thereof, with which the [kind of quiver called] قرن [i. e. قَرَنٌ] is covered. (TA.) You say, غَتَّهُ بِجُشَمِهِ meaning He threw his breast upon him. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
